description: This file is a shell script that sets up and executes a series of tests related to the 'git rebase' command, specifically testing the incompatibility of certain rebase options with different rebase modes and configurations. It defines test functions and invokes them with various options to verify correct behavior.

methods.name: test_rebase_am_only
methods.description: A function that tests the incompatibility of a given rebase option with various other rebase flags and settings, ensuring that rebase fails appropriately when incompatible options are used together.
